rationale: Compact profile: edge-case and acceptance lenses ran cleanly against the spec; all 4 story ACs and 4 spec decisions pass, with browser layout/live lookup verification pending Stage 7, and standards were not audited (not in compact profile). 0 deferred; 4 edge-case candidates dismissed after reading src/store/budgets.ts and src/utils/api.ts: they only affect the Created By display (dash or stale name, no wrong attribution, no data impact), and the popup open or a list reload re-triggers resolveCreators, so all are below the emission floor.

business_review.item: AC1: Created By visible in budget list/management view as a table column
business_review.notes: created_by column added; rendered via getBudgetCreatorDisplay with names from budgetsStore.creatorNames

business_review.item: AC2: Creator shown in detail view for human creator
business_review.notes: BudgetDetailsPopup renders 'Created by' via getBudgetCreatorDisplay and triggers resolveCreators for the creator

business_review.item: AC3: Config/predefined budget without human creator handled gracefully
business_review.notes: 'System' for is_preconfigured or created_by === 'system', '—' otherwise; 'system' id skipped from lookups

business_review.item: AC4: created_by capture and storage unchanged
business_review.notes: No create/update payload or store write path touched; read-side lookup only

business_review.item: UI-only; resolve creator id via existing GET v1/admin/users/{id}
business_review.notes: resolveCreators calls api.get('v1/admin/users/<encoded id>', { skipErrorHandling: true }); no backend change

business_review.item: Config budgets show 'System'; unknown or soft-deleted creators show '—'
business_review.notes: deleted_at -> null, permanent 4xx -> null, null renders '—'; transient failures leave id unresolved, also '—'

business_review.item: Read-only 'Budget details' popup via 'View details' row action for admin, maintainer, auditor, incl. preconfigured budgets
business_review.notes: Actions column no longer gated by canManageBudgets; View details always present; Edit gated by canManageBudgets && !is_preconfigured

business_review.item: Table layout otherwise unchanged from main (only Created By column added)
business_review.notes: Column order unchanged with Created By inserted; widths rebalanced; Actions shown to non-managers per View details decision

business_review.item: Rendered table/popup layout and live user lookups in browser
business_review.notes: Column width fit, popup appearance and network behavior need browser/screenshot evidence

standards_review.notes: Standards audit not part of compact profile
